page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is provisioned with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server configuration does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity does not feature complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Users must provision external storage volumes and network resources separately to meet operational requirements.

With a one-to-one ratio of vCPUs to memory, the ecs.c2.medium is structured for compute-heavy tasks that do not demand large memory footprints. This hardware profile is suited for workloads such as batch processing, high-performance computing tasks, and CPU-bound microservices. The lack of local storage and low memory-to-CPU ratio represents a tradeoff for memory-intensive databases or applications requiring high-speed local disk input and output.
